rules.statement: An unsuccessful claimant cannot maintain an action under section 247 if he had no right to the property at the date of the seizure.
rules.supporting_quote: Holding that to be the true meaning of this case one must go further and say that in a case where a person cannot be a claimant because he had no interest in the property, he cannot be bound by the last paragraph of section 247 which would make an order rejecting his claim res adjudicata against him.

meta.parties: Ibrahim v. Bawa Sahib Et Al
